proposals.title: Require an estimand and a constructive nonidentifiability check
proposals.claim: Two SCMs can fit the same WT and Mab21l2 intervention distributions while predicting different Gata4 responses; therefore this design alone does not identify the Gata4 intervention.
proposals.mechanism: Construct a small synthetic pair of SCMs and an assumption ledger before mechanism claims. de_score, de_direction and severity_slope measure response agreement, not identification of regulatory edges. This is a validation guard, with no claimed biological score gain.
proposals.falsifier: Attempt the two-SCM construction under explicitly stated minimal assumptions. Reject the objection only if a valid uniqueness argument forces the same Gata4 interventional distribution, or new permitted identifying evidence is supplied.

evidence.says: Prediction is distinct from causal understanding; causal claims require intervention assumptions.
Causal review covers estimands, interventions, confounding, selection and identifiability.

evidence.ref: Zhang et al., Identifiability Guarantees for Causal Disentanglement from Soft Interventions, NeurIPS 2023; https://papers.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2023/file/9d3a4cdf6f70559e8c6fe02170fba568-Paper-Conference.pdf
evidence.says: Setup assumes at least one intervention per latent node; guarantees need restricted mixing and faithfulness and cover unseen intervention combinations.

peer_responses.on: Eligible priors can support prediction; randomized graphs do not identify direct edges.
peer_responses.because: Agree: matched held-out gains support prediction only. Randomization tests graph identity information; balanced randomized interventions test total effects. Target-measured Gata4 literature is quarantined (debate/causal.md; official rules section 10).

declined: Declined claiming the Mab21l2 response identifies Gata4 effects, and declined reviving the persona's historical decoy finding as a measured result: no dataset or result artifact exists here. Target-only suppression remains a planned baseline, not mechanistic evidence.
